<div class="hero"><div class="hero-copy"><div class="eyebrow">MATHEMATICAL STATISTICS & MACHINE LEARNING</div><h1>Learning, inference and complex data</h1><p class="lede">From mathematical theory to reliable learning methods under uncertainty, distribution shift and adversarial behavior.</p><div class="hero-actions"><a class="cta" href="research-en.html">Explore my research →</a><a class="cta secondary" href="experience-en.html">Experience & activities →</a></div></div><div class="hero-art" role="img" aria-label="Abstract blue-and-gold mathematical surface with connected points"></div></div><div class="home-cards"><a class="feature" href="research-en.html"><span class="feature-symbol">∑</span><b>Research ↗</b><span>Theory, methods and statistical guarantees.</span></a><a class="feature" href="publications-en.html"><span class="feature-symbol">≡</span><b>Publications ↗</b><span>Journal articles and manuscripts.</span></a><a class="feature" href="teaching-en.html"><span class="feature-symbol">◇</span><b>Teaching ↗</b><span>Undergraduate, graduate and executive teaching.</span></a><a class="feature" href="impact-en.html"><span class="feature-symbol">◎</span><b>Projects & collaborations ↗</b><span>Research projects and industry challenges.</span></a><a class="feature" href="leadership-en.html"><span class="feature-symbol">⌘</span><b>Academic leadership ↗</b><span>Governance and scientific activities.</span></a><a class="feature" href="experience-en.html"><span class="feature-symbol">↗</span><b>Experience ↗</b><span>Degrees, appointments and visits.</span></a></div><div class="home-bottom"><div class="bio"><div class="eyebrow">ABOUT</div><h2>About my work</h2><p>My research began with nonparametric statistics, inverse problems and quantum homodyne tomography. It now spans contrastive conditional-density estimation, causal and counterfactual inference, high-dimensional clustering, neural-network generalization and robust decentralized learning. My developing research on adversarial machine learning investigates attacks, defenses and guarantees. I combine mathematical theory, algorithm design, doctoral supervision, teaching and collaborations with academic and industrial partners.</p><p><a href="experience-en.html">More about my background →</a></p></div><figure class="photo"><img src="kabylie.jpg" alt="Personal photograph of a flower-filled meadow in Kabylie"><figcaption>Kabylie, Algeria · Personal photograph</figcaption></figure><aside class="home-news research-progress"><div class="eyebrow">RESEARCH DIRECTIONS</div><h2>Research in progress</h2><p>CoHiRF and VertCoHiRF investigate consensus in centralized and federated clustering; MCD develops contrastive conditional-density estimation, with applications to causal and counterfactual inference; AdaCap and MLR address neural-network generalization. Research on robust and adversarial learning is expanding.</p><p><a href="research-en.html">Read the research programme →</a></p></aside></div>
